      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "whether NodeClock::now() influencing the parameters causes an anonymity break",
      "quote": "Is there any anonymity breaking via `NodeClock::now()` influencing these parameters?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author showed parameters change only roughly every 22 days and quantizing would not gain much",

      "fix_pushed": false,

    {
      "id": "c:5269371252",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "presync height can exceed INT_MAX and overflow on long timewarp chains",
      "quote": "For the long timewarp chains you mention, the presync height can exceed `INT_MAX` and overflow.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added a commit to use int64_t",

      "other_replies": [],

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "ComputeHeadersSyncParams() hangs indefinitely for small minchainwork heights and short timespans",

      "status_note": "fixed with bounded loop iterations and assumptions",
      "author_replies": ["c:5346650795", "c:5357592309"],
      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "c:5346650795",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "move the HeadersSyncParams definition from chainparams to the headersync module",

      "id": "rc:4009020433",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "avoid square root indirection by using gamma and memory_factor directly",
      "quote": "Why is this square root \"indirection\" necessary? Using `gamma = bufsize / period` (intuitively \"bits of security\") and `memory_factor = (max_headers - mcw_headers) / COMPACT_HEADER_SIZE` directly seem",

      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "superseded when author rewrote the algorithm to drop batch assumptions",
      "author_replies": ["c:5671114593", "c:5685669580"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5250047249",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK 526db3911d400b793e5715c0f989f1d3b66ac12e"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4009670918",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "the parameter search underestimates attack rate by assuming attackers cannot abort mid-batch",
      "quote": "this routine underestimates the rate, because an incomplete batch sent by an attacker may be detected, but will still lead to processing as many headers from the buffer",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "rewritten with single-header arrival model",
      "author_replies": ["c:5671114593", "c:5685669580"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5685669580",
      "status_by_quote": "Rewritten to take that approach. The commit history is simpler now too"

      "id": "rc:4048544161",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "asks whether Step 2 is still useful under the new approach and suggests dropping or simplifying it",
      "quote": "Is Step 2 really useful anymore with the new approach?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author simplified Step 2 to check only floor and ceil of optimal period, which reviewer accepted",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4050560007"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4050783818",
      "status_by_quote": "Neat."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4214406451",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "asks why Assume is used rather than Assert for preconditions, and whether zero inputs could cause division by zero or infinity-to-integer conversion in production",
      "quote": "is there a reason to use `Assume` (rather than `Assert`) for these preconditions? Shouldn't these abort in production? It seems to me that zero inputs could theoretically still lead to division by zero or an infinity-to-integer conversion.",

      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    },

      "id": "rc:4215432352",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "the floating-point bisection loop can infinite-loop due to x87 excess precision",
      "quote": "Digging further with AI pointed to x87 excess precision: a midpoint can compare between the endpoints, then round back to one when stored, leaving the loop with no progress.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to integer bisection over bufsize",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4223034868", "rc:4223043409"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4223043409",
      "status_by_quote": "Fixed, but with a much better alternative: do the bisection over integer `bufsize` values"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4215548260",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "move HeadersSyncParams and return the struct directly from ComputeHeadersSyncParams instead of std::pair",
      "quote": "Since we already have a `HeadersSyncParams` type could we move it and use it here as well (as @darosior also hinted I think)?",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "moved HeadersSyncParams to headerssync.h in a later commit",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4223054953"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4223054953",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, in a later commit."

    {
      "id": "rc:4215563224",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "drop the headers_sync_params test override and use the existing fixed fuzz clocks",
      "quote": "With the rewrite down to about 3 µs per call and fixed clocks already in these fuzz targets, is the override still worth keeping?",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author removed the fuzz override and attributed the change",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4223057506"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4223057506",
      "status_by_quote": "Done, and attributed."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4215577524",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "track only fail_buf while growing the search range and derive succ_buf at the end",
      "quote": "Since `fail_buf = 2 * succ_buf + 1` throughout the growth loop, we can grow just `fail_buf` internally and derive `succ_buf` at the end.",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the single-bound growth simplification",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4222945901"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4222945901",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "simplify the remainder calculation using the modulo operator",
      "quote": "Unless I'm missing something, this could be simplified to modulo, see https://godbolt.org/z/53PfMqxnj.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the modulo operator",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4223031132"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4223031132",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4216190418",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "drop the unnecessary BasicTestingSetup fixture in headerssync_tests",
      "quote": "Nit: this only tests `ComputeHeadersSyncParamsInner` (which doesn’t need the node setup), could we drop the fixture?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author dropped the fixture",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4222944637"],
      "other_replies": [],

      "kind": "maintenance",

      "status": "answered",

    {
      "id": "rc:4216439505",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "style",
      "text": "separate expected headers from probability calculation in attack_rate",
      "quote": "Nit: I find the preceding `2^-K * ...` form easier to follow. Could we separate the expected headers from the probability of passing the first `K` checks here?",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted the separation",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4223032721",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4216461724",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "explore whether restricting the buffer to whole commitment periods could eliminate both searches",
      "quote": "I wonder whether we need to find the optimum this precisely. If we restricted the buffer to whole commitment periods, we could calculate its size directly, and a logarithmic estimate might replace the period search too.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author prefers finding the exact optimum and added a comparison commit with a naive search",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4222997179"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4222997179",
      "status_by_quote": "I still like the fact that it actually finds *the* optimal solution (within rounding precision) to a well-defined (but weakened) variant of the real problem"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4216477737",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "precompute std::log2(attack_headers) once in the lambda capture",
      "quote": "Nit: The attack budget stays fixed during this search, so we could calculate its logarithm once in the capture.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author precomputed the logarithm in the capture",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4223034130"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4223034130",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
